responsibility: Carries the vendored Rust community code-of-conduct text for the embedded datafrog dependency used by gccrs’s Polonius-based borrow-checking stack. It is project-governance documentation only, defining expected contributor and moderation behavior for that upstream crate, and it does not participate in GCC compilation, analysis, diagnostics, fact generation, or FFI.
same_name_distinction: This CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md is the copy vendored with the datafrog dependency under vendor/datafrog/, distinguishing it from the same-named file under vendor/rustc-hash/ only by which upstream crate in the Polonius dependency stack it accompanies.
